hook.name: OneTimeLaunchHookTemplate
hook.description: A launch hook that restricts pool initialization and initial liquidity addition to once per token. In afterSwap, it tracks buy-direction swap recipients and can revert sell-direction swaps for addresses not on a deployer-managed allowlist. Makes non-standard calls (msgSender, msgTarget, msgData) on the token contract that will revert on standard ERC-20 tokens.
